items.question: How long does set-up take?
items.answer: Most businesses take their first booking within ten minutes: you only need to enter your services and opening hours. If you like, our team does the set-up with you on a screen share.

items.question: Do my customers need to install an app?
items.answer: No. Your booking page opens in the browser on any phone; customers book without signing up, using only their name and phone number.

items.question: Do reminder messages cost extra?
items.answer: The Business and Multi-location plans include 500 SMS or WhatsApp messages every month. Beyond that you pay for what you use; unit prices are shown clearly in the dashboard.

items.question: Is there a contract or commitment?
items.answer: No. You pay monthly and can cancel in any month. If you choose yearly billing, you get two months free.

items.question: Does it work with Google Calendar?
items.answer: Yes. Sedir syncs both ways with Google Calendar and Outlook; your personal events show up as busy time and their details are never shown to customers.

items.question: Can I export my data?
items.answer: Yes. You can download your customer list and booking history as a spreadsheet at any time. If you close your account, your data is deleted within the stated period.
